record.question: The forward-path transfer function of unity feedback system is G(s) = K(s+2)/((s+1)(s²+4s+1)). The range of K, for which will be only two closed loop RHP poles, is
record.explanation: Held: printed page 3 has G(s)=K(s+2)/[(s²+1)(s+4)(s−1)], unlike the packet denominator. With negative unity feedback the characteristic polynomial is s⁴+3s³−3s²+(K+3)s+2K−4, whose Routh first column is 1, 3, −(K+12)/3, K(K+33)/(K+12), 2K−4; exactly two RHP poles occur for K>2, absent from the supplied options. The packet’s cubic denominator also yields no range with exactly two RHP poles, so the stem/options require review.
